movie.title: The Intern
movie.overview: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a passionate young fashion company CEO hires a wise elderly silver intern, an unexpected bond forms that bridges generational divides and transforms both of their lives.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seon-wu is a dedicated and ambitious CEO driving her fast-growing fashion company toward success through relentless work ethic. Seeking a unique perspective, the company launches a senior internship program, welcoming Ki-ho, a man rich with decades of life experience. Despite initial skepticism about his fit in a fast-paced digital environment, Ki-ho's subtle wisdom, calm composure, and grounded advice quickly make him an indispensable ally. Together, they navigate work stress, personal growth, and the true meaning of leadership.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seon-wu, the energetic and perfectionist CEO of a thriving fashion startup, pours her heart and soul into every detail of her business. As the company expands rapidly, management decides to launch a silver intern program to foster diversity and gain broader perspectives. Enter Ki-ho, a gentle and observant senior citizen who brings decades of life experience and timeless courtesy into a modernized, tech-driven workplace. At first, Seon-wu views Ki-ho's presence as a mere publicity initiative or a potential distraction in her fast-paced world. However, Ki-ho quietly goes to work, using his emotional intelligence, practical wisdom, and keen observational skills to support those around him. He gradually becomes a stabilizing anchor for the overburdened staff and earns Seon-wu's trust through his genuine care and non-judgmental guidance. When high-pressure business challenges and personal dilemmas threaten to overwhelm Seon-wu, Ki-ho offers steady mentorship that helps her regain balance. Through their heartwarming dynamic, Seon-wu learns to navigate the heavy burdens of executive leadership without sacrificing her personal well-being. Ultimately, their intergenerational bond reshapes the company culture and leaves a lasting impact on everyone involved.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Intern is a warmhearted drama-comedy centered on Seon-wu, a driven and passionate CEO leading a modern fashion enterprise. Seeking fresh insights while promoting social value, her company introduces a senior internship initiative and brings on Ki-ho, a seasoned elder brimming with life wisdom. As the high-energy world of modern corporate fashion collides with Ki-ho's traditional, measured approach, both Seon-wu and her team discover the invaluable power of human connection, patient mentorship, and shared mutual respect.

themes.theme: Adapting to Change in the Workplace

story_structure.climax: A major operational crisis and personal turning point force Seon-wu to confront key decisions about the company's direction and her own personal well-being.
story_structure.conflict: Generational gaps, contrasting work ethics, and dynamic workplace expectations create initial friction as Seon-wu's fast-paced environment collides with Ki-ho's traditional, measured approach to life and work.
story_structure.resolution: Through mutual respect and shared growth, Seon-wu and Ki-ho forge an enduring balance, demonstrating how fresh passion and seasoned experience can meaningfully enrich one another.
story_structure.introduction: Seon-wu, the intense and deeply passionate CEO of a fast-growing fashion company, brings on Ki-ho—a wise, seasoned individual with decades of life experience—as a senior 'silver' intern.
story_structure.risingAction: As Ki-ho begins applying his quiet wisdom and interpersonal skill to everyday workplace challenges, he earns the trust of his younger colleagues and begins to offer subtle support to Seon-wu amid rising corporate pressures.
